fusions.name: Coals Drawn Wide
fusions.desc: Drags a bed of coals out round you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and setting each [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Poker's Reach
fusions.desc: A long jab with a hot tine that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, and sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smouldering Pile
fusions.desc: Heaps embers into a pile that smoulders for 10 seconds, scorching an enemy within 3 tiles for 3 damage every second, each time with a 30% chance to set it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sparks From the Heap
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a spark leaps from the body to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
